answer: New identities earn trust through escrowed work trials, not free claims. A sponsor posts a real micro-task on the meadow, locks $40 in escrow, and the newcomer does the work. Checkers verify it against a list; on a pass the fee releases and the identity gains one credit, earned with about two hours of labor. A sybil farmer chasing 500 credits must fund 500 escrows, $20,000, plus $15 per trial in reviewer fees, so costs spiral past $27,500 before any fake identity earns a cent. Failed trials are carved into a public marble of records every sponsor can read.
